I can't advise on whether you should buy a home or keep renting. That decision depends on your personal finances, goals and risk tolerance, which is personal advice I can't give.

If you want Canadian data to inform your own comparison, Statistics Canada has tables that could help. Table 18-10-0205 (New housing price index, monthly) covers new-home prices by geography, including Toronto. Table 46-10-0092 (Asking rent and paid rent prices, by rental unit type and number of bedrooms, experimental estimates) covers rents by census metropolitan area, which includes Toronto. I did not fetch any values from these tables, so I have no figures to share. Note that the search returned weaker-than-usual ranking, so confirm each table's Toronto geography when you open it.
